newsitem.title: USA: British Air, American Air to brief media on Friday.
newsitem.headline: British Air, American Air to brief media on Friday.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines and British Airways Plc will host a media conference on Friday to make an "important announcement" about their proposed transatlantic alliance.
The press conference will be held at the Capital Hilton in Washington at 1000 EST/1500 GMT.

Will Ris, American's vice president of government affairs, Rob Britton, American's managing director of corporate communications, and David Holmes, British Airways' director of corporate resources, will speak at the presentation.
American Airlines and British Airways were not immediately available for further comment.
